description: Creates a secure Stripe checkout link for a Vidaro credit pack for the signed-in user. Nothing is charged until the user opens the link and pays; credits are then added automatically. When to use: the user is out of credits, an estimate exceeds their balance and they want to continue, or they ask to buy credits. Returns: checkout_url, credits, price, and all packs (small, medium, large) with prices. Give the user the link.
